title: cyclosorus griffithianus
intro: Cyclosorus griffithianus, commonly known as the Griffith's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus griffithianus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of Cyclosorus griffithianus may help to reduce oxidative stress, improve immune function, and modulate the body's response to inflammation.
